prTitle: Add config defaults and user filtering helpers
prDescription: Introduces a helper that mutates a config object and a helper that branches on a boolean flag for active users.

reviewQuality.summary: A utility file introduces one mutation leak and one boolean-flag API that obscures intent.
reviewQuality.reviewGoal: A strong reviewer should surface both issues without drifting into generic utility cleanup advice.

mustFind.description: Flags the boolean flag API in getUsers

mustAvoid.description: Avoids generic comments about hardcoded sample data

prioritise.description: The first comment should be one of the two structural issues

dimensions.name: correctness
dimensions.description: Did the review identify the two actual maintainability issues in the file?

dimensions.name: specificity
dimensions.description: Did the review explain the engineering cost of the mutation leak and boolean flag API concretely?

dimensions.name: restraint
dimensions.description: Did the review avoid inventing secondary issues around the sample array data?
